observations.body: Jesus takes Peter, John, and James up the mountain to pray; sleep, waking, Moses and Elijah, Peter’s tents, the cloud, the voice, and the disciples’ silence gather in Luke’s telling.
observations.label: About eight days after these sayings

observations.body: The passage presents Sleep, waking, speech, and silence as the scene's observable response or movement.
observations.label: Sleep, waking, speech, and silence

observations.body: The passage places The voice names the chosen Son beside Sleep, waking, speech, and silence.
observations.label: The voice names the chosen Son

payload.posture: Read Luke 9:28–36 as one movement in Peter's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states jesus takes Peter, John, and James up the mountain to pray; sleep, waking, Moses and Elijah, Peter’s tents, the cloud, the voice, and the disciples’ silence gather in Luke’s telling. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Peter's story.
payload.title: About eight days after these sayings
